name: Après le considérant AE – 12
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the fisheries exploiting demersal stocks in the Western Mediterranean Sea
part_text: AEa. whereas in its 2024 implementation report the Commission considers that the MAP has proven to be a beneficial framework to implement the common fisheries policy for the western Mediterranean; whereas, according to the same report, over a five-year transition period, the MAP has achieved better fisheries control, for example through the keeping of annual authorised vessel lists and the adoption of conservation measures such as the establishment of efficient closure areas; whereas the report also finds that the MAP provided for a range of flexibility measures to help the sector transition to more sustainable practices, such as effort transfers and alternative effective spatial closures;
